why: a stocked home budgets its outposts' haul on the path its carriers walk, not the straight line: on gen 5 E9S9 took E9S8 at a straight 58 ticks whose haul walks ~120 out its north gap, so Economy cast half the far carriers it needed and the outposts' dig decayed while upgraders drew the stock (main: upgrade 71k from t18000 to t24000, E8S9 and E9S8 decayed 23k)
